note: Signals of a waterbody. Threshold signals grade 0 below the threshold, 0.5 at it and 1 at the severe value, as in the watershed atlas. Boolean signals ('expr') are 1 when true. Variables are computed in seft/wb/indicators.py; MWS fields come from the home MWS (mws_*, ctx_*, share_*). k, kr and krz are percentages of the waterbody's full extent holding water in kharif, kharif and rabi, and kharif, rabi and zaid.

signals.label: Fills poorly in kharif
signals.note: Kharif fill in years without drought in the home MWS (all years if none) in the lowest 20% (severe 10%) of waterbodies of the same type that hold water in 3 or more years. Pooled because a waterbody's extent counts every year's water, so typical fill differs by type.

signals.label: Loses most water by rabi
signals.note: Water area in rabi at or below 60% of the kharif area (severe 30%).

signals.label: Dries up by summer
signals.note: Water area through zaid (summer) at or below 30% of the kharif area (severe 10%).

signals.label: Filling less than its neighbours, year on year
signals.note: Theil-Sen trend of relative fill (kharif fill divided by the median fill of the tehsil's waterbodies that year) at or below -0.08 a year (severe -0.16): over 2017-24 the waterbody fills about half as well, relative to its neighbours, as it did at first. Dividing by the tehsil's median removes the effect of the year's rainfall (2023 was a drought year almost everywhere).

signals.label: Stopped holding water recently
signals.note: Relative fill (kharif fill divided by the tehsil's median that year) in the last two years at or below 30% (severe 10%) of the first three years, for waterbodies that filled to 30% or more at first. Each of the last two years must also be at 15% fill or less (changed 22 Nov 2026 from their average).

signals.label: Fails in drought years
signals.note: Kharif fill in the home MWS's drought years (4 or more moderate or severe drought weeks) at or below half (severe a quarter) of the fill in other years.

signals.label: No water in summer
signals.note: Mean share of the extent holding water through zaid at or below 5% (severe 1%).

signals.label: Water lasts into rabi
signals.note: Mean share of the extent holding water through rabi at or above 40% (severe 60%).

signals.label: Little second-season cropping around it
signals.note: Mean cropping intensity in the zone of influence at or below 1.2 (severe 1.05).

signals.label: Cropping intensity falling around it
signals.note: Theil-Sen trend of cropping intensity in the zone of influence at or below -0.02 a year (severe -0.05).

signals.label: Summer water falling
signals.note: Theil-Sen trend of the zaid water share at or below -2 percentage points a year (severe -5).

signals.label: Small catchment for its size
signals.note: Catchment no more than 5 times the waterbody's area: it may not produce enough runoff to fill it.

signals.label: Large catchment for its size
signals.note: Catchment 20 or more times the waterbody's area: runoff should be ample, so poor filling points to blocked or diverted inflow.

signals.label: Hard rock aquifer
signals.note: Home MWS on a hard-rock aquifer (watershed context): little storage underground, so surface storage and recharge matter more.

signals.label: Alluvial aquifer
signals.note: Home MWS on an alluvial aquifer (watershed context).

signals.label: Semi-arid or dry sub-humid
signals.note: Home MWS semi-arid or dry sub-humid (watershed rainfall context, from the district normal).

signals.label: Eroding catchment
signals.note: Home MWS with 30% or more sloping land, a runoff ratio of 25% or more, or 4% or more farmland degradation: silt load is likely to be high.

signals.label: Groundwater stressed
signals.note: Block stage of groundwater extraction 70% or more (CGWB semi-critical or worse).

signals.label: Zone of influence known
signals.note: A zone of influence was joined to the waterbody, so the cropping it supports is known.

signals.label: Holds water in 3 or more years and not new
signals.note: Holds water in 3 or more of the 8 years and is not new; most rules need this series length.

grading: A threshold signal is graded 0 when its threshold is not crossed, 0.5 at the threshold, rising in proportion to 1 at the severe threshold (seft/signals.py grade). A yes/no signal is 1 or 0. Pooled signals take their thresholds from percentiles of waterbodies of the same type ('pool'). A signal with a 'gate' is 0 where the gate does not hold.
